description: This file defines the JoinedDate class, a filter field for report queries related to employee joining dates within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterField class and incorporates date handling traits to add date-based conditions to database queries.

classes.name: JoinedDate
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering employees based on their join date, supporting operators for less than, greater than, and between.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds date-based conditions to the query builder based on the filter's operator and values.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the alias 'employee' for use in query conditions.
